doc: The 'detached' group of host calls (cleat#3827). Each call is listed here as unbound ('pending: ...') until its binding lands; the PR that binds a call moves its entry from 'unbound' to 'bound' in THIS file and touches no other inventory file. See packages/cleat-ts/groups/README.md.

unbound.cleat_run_detached: pending: start a workflow nobody waits for.
unbound.cleat_start_detached: pending: start a detached workflow and keep its run id.
